classes.label: Social Post
classes.comment: A post published on the Twitter/X platform.

classes.label: Social Post Observation
classes.comment: Mutable engagement-metric snapshot for a social post at crawl time.

classes.label: Twitter Account
classes.comment: A Twitter/X user account that authored a post.

classes.label: Institution
classes.comment: An institution referenced within a social post.

classes.label: Strategic Tag
classes.comment: A strategic classification tag applied to social content.

objectProperties.label: has author
objectProperties.comment: Links a social post to the account that authored it.

objectProperties.label: mentions institution
objectProperties.comment: Links a social post to a referenced institution.

objectProperties.label: has strategic tag
objectProperties.comment: Links a social post to a strategic classification tag.

datatypeProperties.label: post URL
datatypeProperties.comment: Canonical URL of the social post.

datatypeProperties.label: text
datatypeProperties.comment: Full text content of the social post.

datatypeProperties.label: published at
datatypeProperties.comment: Publication timestamp of the social post.

datatypeProperties.label: image URL
datatypeProperties.comment: URL of an image attached to the social post.

datatypeProperties.label: video URL
datatypeProperties.comment: URL of a video attached to the social post.

datatypeProperties.label: author avatar URL
datatypeProperties.comment: Denormalized avatar URL of the post author.

datatypeProperties.label: display name
datatypeProperties.comment: Display name of the Twitter account.

datatypeProperties.label: view count
datatypeProperties.comment: Number of post views at observation time.

datatypeProperties.label: star count
datatypeProperties.comment: Number of stars/bookmarks at observation time.

datatypeProperties.label: share count
datatypeProperties.comment: Number of shares/retweets at observation time.

datatypeProperties.label: like count
datatypeProperties.comment: Number of likes at observation time.

datatypeProperties.label: comment count
datatypeProperties.comment: Number of comments/replies at observation time.

approval.rationale: Conservative raw-grounded mapping: stable identifiers and text content on SocialPost entity; mutable engagement counters (view/star/share/like/comment) on SocialPostObservation. blogger_name promoted to hasAuthor relation targeting TwitterAccount entity with displayName label property; avatar_url retained as denormalized authorAvatarUrl on entity since scalar subject is limited to entity|observation. institution_infos object array mapped as mentionsInstitution relation to Institution entity (assumed nested fields /institution_id and /institution_name). strategic_tag_ids string array mapped as hasStrategicTag relation to StrategicTag concept using the tag id itself as both identifier and label. image_urls and video_urls kept as multi-valued datatype properties per contract since media URLs are not among the listed semantic array types requiring typed-node relations.
